reviews.text:
Purchased a new home, closed 12/5/25. So far, few issues: gouge in the door, unpainted areas, doorbell chime not working.

However, we brought over our fridge from our former residence. When plugged in, it tripped the GFCI outlet next to the Fridge. Chris (Construction Site Manager or somesuch) had someone out the next morning to fix the outlet. Unfortunately, we are still out $250 in cold and frozen foods and Jack's (Community Manager) response was "Like all warranties, there is no compensation [for] consequential damages."

So! When you move in, before you bring over perishable foods, make sure the outlets work! They don't care about you once you sign on the dotted line beyond contractual obligations (warranty work).
reviews.author: Shawn Abraham

reviews.text: Jack Community manager and Chris the Construction manager are the best ever work with. They are very respectful, Attentive and listen to you. They will go extra lengths to get the work done. Communication and updates during construction was great.

data.summary: The Google reviews show signs of both authenticity and potential manipulation. The low volume is suspicious for a home builder. The 1-star and 3-star reviews are highly detailed and credible, citing specific managers, problems, and financial losses. The 5-star reviews are mostly vague and could be solicited. The overall story suggests a builder with real quality/customer service issues, possibly offset by a small number of generic positive reviews.
fake_signals: Very low review volume (11 total) for a home builder
Multiple 5-star reviews are extremely brief/vague ('Beautiful home', empty review)
5-star reviews lack specific project details; focus on staff personalities
Potential for review solicitation from staff/partners
authentic_signals: Specific complaints with details (mice infestation due to roof gaps, $250 food loss, door gouge)
Varied writing styles and specific names/dates mentioned in complaints
Owner responses (implied in review text) show a real business interaction
complaint_patterns: Poor customer service from specific manager (Jack)
Construction quality issues (gaps, mice, gouges, unpainted areas)
Unresponsive to compensation requests for damages
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only one primary review source (Google) with a consistent rating. No other platforms have ratings to compare.
